ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

fsm_states_card.name: Inactive
fsm_states_card.description: Card has no clock/voltage or has been forced inactive (CMD15). Ignores all commands until re-powered.

fsm_states_card.name: Idle
fsm_states_card.description: After CMD0 or power-on. RCA = 0x0000. Card waits for CMD8 (v2.0) and ACMD41.

fsm_states_card.name: Ready
fsm_states_card.description: ACMD41 finished initialization; card waiting for CMD2 (ALL_SEND_CID).

fsm_states_card.name: Identification
fsm_states_card.description: Between CMD2 and CMD3. Card has sent CID and is waiting for new RCA assignment.

fsm_states_card.name: Stand-by
fsm_states_card.description: Card identified with RCA; card not selected. Most non-data commands allowed (CMD9/CMD10/CMD4/CMD7/CMD13/CMD15).

fsm_states_card.name: Transfer
fsm_states_card.description: Card selected (CMD7 with matching RCA); ready for data commands.

fsm_states_card.name: Sending-data
fsm_states_card.description: Card driving DAT for a read (CMD17/CMD18) or status (ACMD13/ACMD22/ACMD51).

fsm_states_card.name: Receive-data
fsm_states_card.description: Card receiving data on DAT for a write (CMD24/CMD25).

fsm_states_card.name: Programming
fsm_states_card.description: Card writing received data to flash; DAT0 held LOW (busy).

fsm_states_card.name: Disconnect
fsm_states_card.description: Card has finished programming and disconnected from DAT; entered from Programming by CMD7 with non-matching RCA.

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_POWER_UP
fsm_states_host.description: Apply VDD; wait for VDD ramp + ≥ 1 ms + 74 dummy CLK cycles.

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_INIT
fsm_states_host.description: CMD0 → CMD8 → ACMD41 loop with VDD window + HCS + S18R; until OCR.BUSY=1.

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_IDENT
fsm_states_host.description: CMD2 → CMD3 → CMD9 → CMD7 to select.

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_CONFIG
fsm_states_host.description: ACMD51 (SCR), ACMD6 (bus width), CMD6 (Switch Function for High Speed / UHS-I), CMD19 (Tuning if UHS-I SDR104), CMD16 (SET_BLOCKLEN if SDSC).

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_TRANSFER
fsm_states_host.description: CMD17/CMD18/CMD24/CMD25 with optional CMD23 (SET_BLOCK_COUNT) or CMD12 (STOP_TRANSMISSION).

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_IDLE
fsm_states_host.description: Optional polling via CMD13 (SEND_STATUS); cache maintenance via CMD48/CMD49 (Function Extension).

fsm_hints.trigger: Host drives all commands; card never initiates a transaction. CMD0 is the universal reset.
fsm_hints.rule: Card-state encoding in R1 bits 12:9 reports the card state at the moment the response was generated.
fsm_hints.abort: CMD12 STOP_TRANSMISSION cleanly stops multi-block read/write; CMD15 GO_INACTIVE_STATE removes a card from the bus; CMD0 resets.

anti_deadlock_rule: Host shall poll DAT0 (busy LOW) before issuing a dependent command after a programming command, OR shall use CMD13 (SEND_STATUS) on the CMD line (allowed during Programming).
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on or CMD0, card enters Idle state, RCA = 0x0000, CMD line is open-drain. Card must complete init within 1 second of valid ACMD41.

default_ready_state_recommendation.CMD_idle: HIGH (mark); open-drain during identification, push-pull thereafter.
default_ready_state_recommendation.DAT_idle: HIGH; DAT0 LOW = busy signal during programming.
default_ready_state_recommendation.CLK_idle: Implementation-defined; host may stop CLK between transactions (Default / High Speed; UHS-II is always-on).

configurations.name: SD 1-bit mode
configurations.description: Card identifies in this mode by default; only DAT0 is used. CLK + CMD + DAT0.

configurations.name: SD 4-bit mode
configurations.description: After ACMD6 = 0b10; DAT0..DAT3 active. Default high-throughput mode.

configurations.name: SPI mode
configurations.description: Host pulls CS LOW during CMD0; card enters SPI mode permanently until reset. CLK + CS + DI + DO. Subset of commands.

timing_dependency_rule: All commands and data block transfers are synchronous to CLK. In Default Speed the card samples on the rising edge of CLK; in High Speed (CMD6 group 1 = 0x1) the card samples on the falling edge of CLK to relax host timing. UHS-I SDR / DDR / SDR104 add per-mode tuning (CMD19) to find an optimal sampling point.
